messages:
tyler: Pushing a simple mockup of the new schema editor in Playground — focuses on inline function definitions + structured-output preview. Link: https://figma.redwood/mockups/pg-schema-ux

tyler: Key asks: 1) is inline editing better than modal for functions? 2) how does run history fit? 3) accessibility nits

maria: Love the inline idea. Quick thought: collapse long param lists by default. :+1:

alex: Agree with collapse. For run history, can we show a compact timeline with input/outputs collapsed, and a diff view for output schema changes? Example:

```
Run #12 — success — 2026-03-22 13:02
Inputs: 3 items
Output schema diff: +address, -location
```

sam: Copy nit: primary button should be "Save schema" not "Apply" — clearer for end users.

janet: Accessibility: When editing functions, the name + signature should be a single focusable region, arrow keys navigate params, ESC closes edit. Also ensure labels are visible (not only placeholder).

designbot: accessibility-check: contrast on `.editor-toolbar` header is 3.8:1 — below 4.5:1 for small text. Flagging.

tyler: Good catches — I'll update to "Save schema" and do param collapse by default. For inline vs modal: pros/cons in thread:

- Inline: faster, better context, easier to show structured-output preview
- Modal: less page churn, safer for complex edits

maria: Could we hybrid — inline summary that opens a compact modal for advanced editing?

alex: Sounds good. Also, consider adding a "Pin to run history" so users can snapshot a run+schema pair.

sam: UX tiny: when function has only simple primitives show a compressed signature like `format(address)`; expand on tap.

janet: Also keyboard shortcut for run history (g r) would be great for power users.

tyler: Action items: I will 1) change button copy, 2) implement default param collapse, 3) add ARIA labels and keyboard nav spec, 4) prototype hybrid inline/modal for advanced edits, 5) add run history pin concept. I'll post a Figma update by EOD. :rocket:

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: :eyes: looking forward to the diff view mockups

designbot: design-lint: missing alt text on preview thumbnail (PR #472)

tyler: noted, thanks. If anyone wants to pair on keyboard nav spec ping me. End.
